privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This portal is operated to authenticate shareholders, display their records, respond to requests, and support governance obligations. It is intended to align with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and related cybersecurity controls.
privacy.dataBody: We process National ID numbers, names in Arabic and English, email addresses, phone numbers, birth details, national address information, stockholder records, transaction history, yearly dividends, certificates, support submissions, and feedback where relevant to your use of the portal.
privacy.purposeBody: Your data is used to verify identity, deliver one-time passcodes, display shareholding information, issue and open documents, respond to support requests, investigate abuse, and maintain legal, financial, and governance records.
privacy.retentionBody: Shareholder, transaction, and dividend records are retained for as long as required by applicable legal, financial, audit, and cooperative governance obligations. Support submissions, feedback, and security rate-limit logs are retained only as long as needed to resolve requests, prevent abuse, and demonstrate compliance.
privacy.rightsTitle: Your rights under the Saudi PDPL
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access to your personal data, correction of inaccurate information, completion of incomplete records, and deletion or restriction where legally permitted. To submit a privacy or data-rights request, use the Contact section inside the portal so your identity can be verified before any disclosure or change is made.
privacy.transferBody: The portal uses Supabase for application infrastructure and Twilio for OTP delivery. These providers may process limited personal data outside the Kingdom when technically necessary, subject to contractual, security, and access-control safeguards.
privacy.securityBody: We apply role-based row-level security, private certificate storage, signed document URLs, OTP verification, rate limiting, session controls, and restricted administrative access to reduce unauthorized disclosure, misuse, and abuse.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy complaints, access requests, correction requests, or questions about this notice, submit a request through the portal contact form and include enough information for the cooperative to verify and handle your request securely.
